selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: For independently deployed Next.js modules, preserve one LinerCore shell by having every canonical app render the same W2-02-owned PlatformShell and route registry; treat the edge proxy as route selection, not HTML composition.

selections.heading: Corrections
selections.text: Place Booking-to-Journey integration in the canonical apps/shell /booking/[bookingId] seam, not apps/booking, unless an approved route-ownership change supersedes the source evidence.

selections.heading: Contract Evolution
selections.text: Keep movement-timeline normalization in the owning provider; BFFs and browsers must not merge expected and actual evidence or calculate lifecycle and next-move truth.

selections.heading: Contract Evolution
selections.text: For CMM v2, use a signed subject assertion and a server-issued signed capture-attempt token to establish subject, idempotency, and correlation without BFF persistence or browser authority.

selections.heading: Forbidden
selections.text: When existing event consumers lack verified poison, DLQ, or replay controls, keep event-path acceptance BLOCKED and document the current partition blast radius; do not invent a new topic outside approved scope.
